title: Potential indefinite block on keep‑alive connections
detail: When a request is keep‑alive, the server calls `stream.read()` to consume any remaining data. If the client never sends an EOF (e.g., keeps the connection open for pipelining), this call blocks forever, preventing the server from handling subsequent requests or shutting down cleanly.

title: Stream list updated incorrectly after accept
detail: The code removes streams that are already closed before appending the newly accepted stream. Since the handler closes the stream in a separate thread, the stream may already be closed when this code runs, causing it to be omitted from the list of active streams. This can lead to missing cleanup or incorrect tracking of active connections.
